description: Sub-file for today live market data containing precomputed short-term static and long-term static data with specific columns, mathematical calculations, and plain-language interpretations.

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 5.6% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 148.8% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 336.3).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 3.6% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 44.63 (3.5%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 55.79 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1292.33. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1309.66), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1257.66).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1275.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 466.7% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 27.7 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1567.31.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 14.5 (4.77%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 18.13 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 302.7. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 308.4), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 298.4).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 22.5 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 314.63.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates DISTRIBUTION_DANGER. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 0.46 per share on a book value of Rs. 101.97 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 835.7% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 32.5).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 37.45 (3.5%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 46.81 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1070. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1070), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1070).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1070.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 375.6% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 236.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 0.34 (3.51%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 0.43 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 9.63. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 9.76), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 9.56).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 9.7.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Graham intrinsic benchmark sits at Rs. 225, offering a 95.7% margin of safety buffer against historical price extremes.
